fixed_added_mass.reason: Turning-circle data weakly observes transient added yaw inertia. These geometry-derived terms are fixed before optimization rather than inferred from an insensitive dataset.
fixed_added_mass.model_mismatch_limitation: Values originate from the HMRI KVLCC2 geometry and are retained for the MARIN model as a documented geometry-transfer assumption.

turning_circle_identified.evidence_role: identification; never reported as held-out validation

held_out_validation.evidence_role: held-out transient-yaw validation; no coefficient fitting permitted

failure_interpretation.rule: If held-out zig-zag overshoot metrics fail after turning-circle damping identification, report a yaw-transient observability and data-coverage limitation, not automatically a simulator defect.
failure_interpretation.basis: captive.csv contains no yaw-rate excitation and steady portions of turning circles constrain yaw damping much more strongly than added yaw inertia
failure_interpretation.prohibited_response: Do not move any held-out zig-zag into identification or relax its tolerance after observing the result.

provenance_requirement: Every fitted coefficient must identify captive, turning-circle, or retained-literature provenance separately.
